questions.passage:
Two small firms have reported lower staff turnover after testing a shorter working week. Employees welcomed the extra free day, and managers say deadlines were still met. The results offer a reason to take the idea seriously, especially in businesses struggling to retain experienced staff.

They do not, however, settle the question for every employer. Both firms could rearrange tasks within small teams. A railway operator cannot simply close its stations for an extra day. The useful next step is to examine what made the trials work and where those conditions exist, rather than treat either enthusiasm or doubt as a substitute for further evidence.
questions.q: The author regards the two trials as
o: a promising result whose wider application needs study.
proof that staff turnover is mainly caused by long hours.
evidence that transport services should adopt the same hours.
an unsuccessful attempt to meet employees' expectations.
questions.target: 局部结果可以支持谨慎推进，不能替代普遍适用性的证据
questions.skill: 局部结果可以支持谨慎推进，不能替代普遍适用性的证据
questions.answer_support: The useful next step is to examine what made the trials work and where those conditions exist

exp.trans: 两家小企业缩短工作周后离职减少，结果值得重视，但其他行业未必具备同样的任务组织条件。
exp.structure: 第一段认可初步成果；第二段说明推广条件，并提出进一步调查的方向。
exp.other: staff turnover：员工流动、离职更替；retain：留住；substitute for：替代。
exp.meaning: 作者既没有否定结果，也没有把小范围成果普遍化；正确项保留“有希望但仍需研究推广条件”的完整评价。
exp.rest: 文中未证明工时是离职的主要原因；铁路例子恰恰说明不能直接照搬；员工欢迎新安排，不能说未达到其期待。

questions.passage:
A booking website crashes whenever too many customers arrive at once. Staff have learned to restart the server, and the service usually returns within minutes. Customers are understandably relieved when it comes back, but the same failure reappears the next busy evening.

An engineer calls the restart a Band-Aid. It restores access without changing the weakness that causes the site to fail under heavy demand. The company still needs to examine how requests are handled and where capacity is lost. A response that ends today's interruption can be useful while remaining inadequate as an answer to the recurring problem.
questions.q: The engineer uses "Band-Aid" to describe a
o: useful but temporary response to the failure.
complete redesign of the booking website.
financial guarantee offered to disappointed customers.
method of preventing every increase in demand.
questions.target: Band-Aid比喻临时补救，不把bank aid回忆补造成既定误译
questions.skill: Band-Aid比喻临时补救，不把bank aid回忆补造成既定误译
questions.answer_support: It restores access without changing the weakness that causes the site to fail

exp.trans: 重启能暂时恢复网站，但高峰时故障反复出现，工程师称它为临时补救。
exp.structure: 第一段给出反复现象，第二段区分恢复当下使用和解决反复成因。
exp.other: Band-Aid：创可贴，引申为临时补救；recurring：反复出现的。
exp.meaning: 正确项保留暂时有用与未解决成因两点。这不是银行援助的表达，也不是说该应急行动毫无作用。
exp.rest: 全面重设计尚未发生；客户财务担保无依据；避免一切需求增长不是重启的作用。

questions.passage:
A field station has been struggling with two different costs. Electricity bills have risen, and floods have repeatedly damaged equipment stored on the ground floor. Its new plan combines rooftop solar panels with raised storage rooms. The former measure should reduce the cost of running instruments during ordinary working days; the latter protects equipment when the river rises.

Staff have long complained that routine electricity costs leave too little money for field visits. The new storage rooms are welcome, but they answer a different concern. The raised rooms should prevent another expensive loss, but they will not lower the regular electricity bill. Managers plan to use the savings from the panels to restore trips that had been cancelled.
questions.q: The staff's complaint about routine operating costs would be addressed mainly by
o: installing the rooftop solar panels.
raising the equipment storage rooms.
replacing instruments after another flood.
reducing the number of planned field visits.
questions.target: former指第一项；核对措施与题干目的
questions.skill: former指第一项；核对措施与题干目的
questions.answer_support: The former measure should reduce the cost of running instruments during ordinary working days

exp.trans: 太阳能板降低日常用电成本，抬高储藏室防止水灾。员工长期抱怨的是常规电费挤占外出经费。
exp.structure: 两项措施并列后分别给出作用；第二段进一步限定题目所问的成本。
exp.meaning: 题干问日常运营开支，应对应前者太阳能板；不能因防洪也出现在计划中就选它。
exp.rest: 抬高储藏室应对水灾；更换灾后仪器增加另一类开支；取消考察不是文中解决电费问题的措施。

questions.passage:
A school district has responded to falling reading scores by buying extra tutoring hours. The help is welcome, particularly for pupils who have missed lessons. Yet the district's own review found that frequent timetable changes were repeatedly interrupting the normal reading classes. Paying for more teaching after school leaves that problem untouched.

The tutoring contract may prevent some pupils from falling further behind. It should not become a reason to postpone a more awkward discussion about how the school day is organised. A system that regularly disrupts its own lessons cannot put matters right simply by purchasing additional ones. The extra help is useful; a dependable timetable is still essential.
questions.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: Why Reading Scores Call for Rapid Action
Extra Lessons Cannot Repair a Broken Timetable
After-School Tutors Deserve Greater Recognition
How Families Can Help Children Read at Home
questions.target: 标题须包含作者对现有措施不充分的评价
questions.skill: 标题须包含作者对现有措施不充分的评价
questions.answer_support: A system that regularly disrupts its own lessons cannot put matters right simply by purchasing additional ones.

exp.trans: 额外辅导有用，但正常阅读课不断被打断，作者主张处理课程安排本身的问题。
exp.structure: 先认可补救，再指出根因仍在，末段要求把改善基本安排纳入对策。
exp.other: dependable：可靠的；put matters right：纠正问题。
exp.meaning: 正确标题抓住额外辅导无法代替稳定课程安排的论点。快速行动与阅读下降相关，但不是作者最强调的区别。
exp.rest: 紧急行动只概括背景需求；肯定辅导教师、家庭阅读均非文章论证中心。

questions.passage:
A company selling automated tutoring software predicts that its product will soon make private lessons unnecessary. It points to students who completed practice exercises more quickly after a week of use. The finding may interest teachers looking for ways to provide extra practice. It tells us much less about the company's larger promise.

Speed on a familiar exercise is not the same as understanding a difficult idea. Nor does a week's use show whether students will retain what they have learned. Before accepting a forecast about the disappearance of private lessons, schools need evidence that addresses those questions. The sales pitch has moved rather further than the research behind it.
questions.q: The author views the company's prediction with
o: relief.
skepticism.
admiration.
indifference.
questions.target: 从证据不足和评价措辞判断怀疑，而非仅凭情绪强弱猜态度
questions.skill: 从证据不足和评价措辞判断怀疑，而非仅凭情绪强弱猜态度
questions.answer_support: The sales pitch has moved rather further than the research behind it.

exp.trans: 软件提高了短期熟练练习的速度，但公司据此预言私人辅导会消失。作者认为研究不足以支持这一大幅扩展的预测。
exp.structure: 先介绍公司预测及其有限证据，再逐项指出证据与预测之间的缺口。
exp.other: retain：保持、记住；sales pitch：推销说辞；skepticism：怀疑。
exp.meaning: 作者不是单纯说不知道结果，而是指出预测超出了现有研究的支持范围，体现skepticism。
exp.rest: relief和admiration没有评价依据；末句已经明确批评推销承诺走得过远，因此不是indifference。

questions.passage:
After severe flooding, a council promised to spare no effort in protecting local homes. The promise was popular, but deciding what it meant proved harder. A concrete wall would protect the town centre while pushing water towards farms downstream. Restoring wetlands would take longer, although it could reduce the pressure on both areas.

Officials eventually proposed a mixture of smaller barriers and wetland restoration. Some residents called this a retreat from the original promise. That criticism confuses determination with a willingness to accept any consequence. A serious effort to protect one community must still take account of the people who live beyond its boundary.
questions.q: In this passage, "spare no effort" is closest in meaning to
o: complete the work without consulting others.
make every effort to achieve the stated goal.
accept whatever damage the project may cause.
give the most expensive proposal preference.
questions.target: spare no effort强调尽力，不自动等于接受任何后果
questions.skill: spare no effort强调尽力，不自动等于接受任何后果
questions.answer_support: That criticism confuses determination with a willingness to accept any consequence.

exp.trans: 市政承诺全力防洪，随后选择兼顾上下游的组合方案。作者认为顾及其他社区不等于没有尽力。
exp.structure: 先给出承诺，接着展示不同方案的利弊，再反驳“考虑后果就是退缩”的批评。
exp.other: determination：决心；downstream：下游；take account of：考虑。
exp.meaning: make every effort对应尽全力的承诺。文中明确区分这种努力和接受任何后果的态度。
exp.rest: 不咨询别人、偏好最贵方案都不是短语含义；接受项目造成的任何损害，恰好混淆了努力与不惜代价。

questions.passage:
A university has drawn up a workable plan to share teaching rooms between departments. The rooms are suitable and the scheduling software has been tested. Approval has nevertheless stalled. Several departments want to retain their customary rooms, while a commercial conference organiser fears losing access during the holidays. Both have pressed the governing committee to leave the arrangements unchanged.

Calling this a failure of the scheduling staff misses the source of the delay. The staff have shown that a different timetable is possible. What they cannot decide is whose claims the committee should give up protecting. The difficulty lies in competing interests being defended through the approval process.
questions.q: The delay in approving the plan results mainly from
o: the staff's inability to operate the scheduling software.
pressure from groups defending existing arrangements.
a shortage of rooms suitable for ordinary teaching.
the organiser's failure to attract holiday conferences.
questions.target: 区分主动施压与能力不足，并保留多个主体
questions.skill: 区分主动施压与能力不足，并保留多个主体
questions.answer_support: The difficulty lies in competing interests being defended through the approval process.

exp.trans: 方案技术可行，但院系和商业会议方都为保留现有权益施压审批委员会。
exp.structure: 可行性事实排除技术无能，再定位实际阻碍是多方利益要求。
exp.meaning: pressure对应利益干预，不是工作人员不会操作。正确项也保留了不止一个群体的范围。
exp.rest: 软件已经测试，教室也适用；文中未说会议方招不到客户。

questions.passage:
A country house has donated several boxes of letters to a public archive. The announcement gives most of the credit to the family that owned them. Its willingness to make the letters available certainly deserves thanks. Without access, historians could have learned little from the collection.

But access alone does not explain why the letters are now attracting scholarly interest. Archivists spent months identifying the writers, putting undated pages in order and connecting scattered references. Their work turned a collection of private papers into a source through which a wider social history can be studied. Celebrating a generous gift should not make the labour that gives it public value disappear from view.
questions.q: The author mentions the archivists' work to show that
o: professional work helped make the collection useful to others.
private ownership had made historical research unnecessary.
the family donated the letters mainly to receive public praise.
historians were mistaken about who originally owned the letters.
questions.target: 区分提供资源与通过整理分析创造用途，保留作者的论点
questions.skill: 区分提供资源与通过整理分析创造用途，保留作者的论点
questions.answer_support: Their work turned a collection of private papers into a source through which a wider social history can be studied.

exp.trans: 家族捐信值得感谢，但档案工作者识别作者、排列材料和关联信息的工作，才让这些材料产生更广泛的研究用途。
exp.structure: 第一段认可开放材料的贡献，第二段补充加工整理的贡献，作者没有简单否定捐赠者。
exp.other: archivist：档案工作者；scattered references：分散的相关线索；credit：功劳。
exp.meaning: 整理和关联资料使私人信件可用于更广泛的历史研究。这支持专业工作创造公共用途的概括，而非单纯持有材料就完成全部贡献。
exp.rest: 私人持有不意味着研究多余；作者没有推断家族动机只是求表扬；也没有讨论历史学家认错所有者。

inference-boundary.passage:
For people leaving work late, the last bus can determine whether a job is worth taking. A transport committee is therefore considering running buses for an extra hour on two routes. The proposal has won support from employers, but the council has not yet agreed to fund it. Existing services will continue while the costs are examined.

Supporters describe the plan as a chance to widen access to work. That may be true, but it is not yet a benefit anyone can use. The difference between a useful proposal and an available service is easily lost when an announcement receives more attention than the decision still needed to carry it out.
inference-boundary.q: What can be learned about the proposed bus service?
o: It has already replaced the existing evening timetable.
It is being reduced because employers oppose the cost.
It will be available as soon as employers request it.
Its extension depends on a funding decision still to come.
inference-boundary.target: 保留提议、可能性与实施事实的区别
inference-boundary.skill: 保留提议、可能性与实施事实的区别
inference-boundary.answer_support: the council has not yet agreed to fund it

exp.trans: 委员会考虑两条线路延长一小时，雇主支持，但拨款尚未批准；现有服务照常运行。
exp.structure: 先交代需求和提议，再指出公众容易把得到关注的方案误当成已经可使用的服务。
exp.other: consider：考虑；fund：提供资金；carry out：实施。
exp.meaning: 未批准资金的事实支持“延长仍取决于后续拨款决定”。considering不能被改写成已经延长，更不能反向改成正在削减。
exp.rest: 现有时刻表未被取代；雇主实际支持方案；雇主提出请求也不等于市政已经批准资金。

band-aid-remedy.passage:
A community arts programme is about to cancel its next season when a sponsor offers a single donation. The gift pays the venue bill and allows the advertised workshops to go ahead. The organisers are grateful, but the programme has lost several regular supporters and has no dependable income for the following year.

One trustee calls the donation a Band-Aid rather than a funding strategy. The point is not to dismiss the sponsor's generosity. It is to recognise that a payment which prevents an immediate cancellation does not establish a reliable way to finance future work. The programme needs both relief now and a plan for what follows.
band-aid-remedy.q: The trustee's description of the donation as a "Band-Aid" stresses its
o: dependence on the venue's willingness to cancel events.
ability to replace the programme's regular supporters.
failure to help with any of the current expenses.
limited role in addressing a continuing funding problem.
band-aid-remedy.target: 区分一次应急支持和可持续解决方案
band-aid-remedy.skill: 区分一次应急支持和可持续解决方案
band-aid-remedy.answer_support: a payment which prevents an immediate cancellation does not establish a reliable way to finance future work

exp.trans: 一次捐款救下本季活动，但并未建立往后的稳定收入来源；作者承认好处并限定其作用。
exp.structure: 先交代危机和缓解，再区分即时救助与持续资助。
exp.other: trustee：受托管理者；dependable：可靠的；relief：缓解、救济。
exp.meaning: 正确项是对持续问题的作用有限，不是把捐赠说成无效或已有完整财务方案。
exp.rest: 场地方取消意愿不是比喻重点；常规支持者流失未被解决；当期场地费确实已获帮助。

former-latter-goal.passage:
Small touring companies often struggle with expensive costumes and duplicated office work. A regional theatre network proposes a shared costume store and a single booking service. The store would let companies borrow items they otherwise had to buy. The latter service would take bookings for every participating company, so that each troupe would no longer need to maintain a separate ticket office.

Administrators have complained for years about answering the same enquiries through several offices. Sharing costumes may save money, but it would not remove that repeated work. The booking proposal is directed at that particular problem. The network hopes the joint office will leave staff more time to arrange school visits and local performances.
former-latter-goal.q: The complaint about repeated administrative work is most directly answered by
o: buying fewer costumes for each production.
giving every troupe its own ticket office.
asking performers to handle audience enquiries.
providing a common booking service.
former-latter-goal.target: latter指第二项；相同主题不等于相同作用
former-latter-goal.skill: latter指第二项；相同主题不等于相同作用
former-latter-goal.answer_support: The booking proposal is directed at that particular problem.

exp.trans: 服装共享减少购置费用，统一订票减少各团重复接待咨询；长期抱怨针对后者所解决的重复工作。
exp.structure: 先列措施并说明作用，再以长期抱怨限定需要对应的目标。
exp.meaning: 正确项对应第二项共同订票服务，保留latter的指向及其解决的问题。
exp.rest: 少买服装处理的是另一项成本；各设票房会继续重复；让演员接咨询没有被提出。

title-coverage.passage:
Applicants for a training grant used to submit the same address details to three offices. A mismatch between the forms could delay an otherwise complete application for weeks. After staff traced the problem, the offices agreed to use one shared form. The change was introduced within days, and most applications could then move through the system without repeated checks of identical information.

There is a temptation to judge a reform's seriousness by how long it takes. This case points the other way. The change was quick because the obstacle was specific and the people involved had authority to remove it. Speed did not make the improvement superficial; it spared applicants another season of unnecessary delay.
title-coverage.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: A Grant Scheme in Need of More Patient Applicants
The Risks of Sharing Information Between Offices
A Swift Reform with Lasting Practical Benefits
Why Major Reforms Must Begin with Longer Forms
title-coverage.target: 不把快速解决一律误判成临时补救
title-coverage.skill: 不把快速解决一律误判成临时补救
title-coverage.answer_support: Speed did not make the improvement superficial

exp.trans: 重复填表造成等待，统一表格迅速移除了具体障碍。作者强调迅速并不等于表面应付。
exp.structure: 第一段呈现原因、行动与结果，第二段明确评价速度与改革价值的关系。
exp.meaning: 本文恰好支持快速且有效的改革。标题判断必须跟随材料，不能学成见到quick就排除。
exp.rest: 要求申请人更耐心、警惕信息共享或延长表格，均不符合作者对这次改革的肯定。

title-coverage.passage:
Public libraries have spent heavily on faster internet connections and new computers. For residents without reliable access at home, those investments matter. Yet librarians report that some visitors still leave without completing the task that brought them in. A working computer is little help to someone unsure how to fill in an online form or judge whether a message is genuine.

Several libraries are now assigning staff to offer short, practical sessions alongside the equipment. The service costs money and takes time away from other duties. But if public access is to mean more than a row of available screens, helping people use the connection deserves a place in the budget too.
title-coverage.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: Bringing Every Library Service Online
A Better Connection Is Only a Beginning
Making Public Computers Pay Their Way
Why Libraries Are Losing Their Readers
title-coverage.target: 标题概括问题与解决方向，不只复现一个话题词
title-coverage.skill: 标题概括问题与解决方向，不只复现一个话题词
title-coverage.answer_support: helping people use the connection deserves a place in the budget too

exp.trans: 图书馆配置网络和电脑后，部分读者仍缺少使用技能；作者主张把人员指导也纳入公共数字服务。
exp.structure: 从硬件投入的成效和不足，推进到实用指导的需求与经费，形成“连接只是起点”的论点。
exp.meaning: 正确标题同时覆盖硬件有用和仅有硬件不够这两层观点，包含文章后半部分提出的支持措施。
exp.rest: 把所有服务搬到线上不是文章主张；让电脑挣钱误读了公共预算讨论；文章也没有说图书馆正在失去读者。

title-coverage.passage:
An empty shop is more than a gap in a shopping street. When several remain vacant, fewer people pass through, and the surviving businesses lose customers. Simply advertising the empty units has done little where the rent and the cost of fitting out a whole shop are beyond a new trader's reach.

A local partnership is now dividing several units into small shared spaces. Traders pay for a stall and basic services instead of taking on an entire building. The arrangement will not rescue every shopping street, but it tackles one reason premises stay unused. Reviving a high street may depend less on finding a single large tenant than on making room for several small ones.
title-coverage.q: Which of the following would be the best title for the text?
o: Why Small Shops Need Larger Buildings
The Cost of Advertising Vacant Properties
Giving Empty Shops a Shared Future
How Large Retailers Choose Their Tenants
title-coverage.target: 从整篇主线概括复兴途径，而非选择背景细节作标题
title-coverage.skill: 从整篇主线概括复兴途径，而非选择背景细节作标题
title-coverage.answer_support: Reviving a high street may depend less on finding a single large tenant than on making room for several small ones.

exp.trans: 空铺加剧街区衰落，整间租用费用又阻挡小商户进入；共享铺位降低门槛，为街区复兴提供一种途径。
exp.structure: 先说明空置问题和原有办法的不足，再解释共享方案及其适用限度。
exp.other: premises：经营场所；fit out：装修配备；tenant：租户。
exp.meaning: 正确标题覆盖空铺问题和共享利用的解决方向。它没有承诺所有街区都能因此获救。
exp.rest: 更大的建筑与小商户实际面临的负担相反；广告费用只是背景且非主线；文章不讨论大型零售商挑选租户。

author-stance.passage:
A city proposes turning a disused sports ground into a park that can hold floodwater during heavy rain. Residents would gain an open space for most of the year, while nearby streets would face a lower risk of flooding. Some critics object that the park would occasionally have to close just when families wanted to use it.

That inconvenience should be acknowledged. It is not, by itself, a convincing reason to abandon a space that serves two useful purposes. The more important questions concern safe access, reliable maintenance and clear warnings before the water rises. With those arrangements in place, the proposal deserves to move beyond the drawing board.
author-stance.q: The author's attitude towards the proposed park is one of
o: unqualified enthusiasm.
general indifference.
persistent hostility.
conditional approval.
author-stance.target: 判断作者的条件性支持，不把承认缺点读成全面反对
author-stance.skill: 判断作者的条件性支持，不把承认缺点读成全面反对
author-stance.answer_support: With those arrangements in place, the proposal deserves to move beyond the drawing board.

exp.trans: 公园兼具日常开放空间和蓄洪用途，作者承认临时关闭不便，但认为落实安全和维护安排后应推进。
exp.structure: 先列出方案利弊，再明确主要条件，结尾给出有条件的支持。
exp.other: drawing board：设计阶段；maintenance：维护；acknowledge：承认。
exp.meaning: 结尾明确说条件落实后值得推进，因此是conditional approval；既非对所有问题无保留赞美，也非仅仅态度不明。
exp.rest: unqualified抹去了条件；indifference与明确建议推进不符；hostility把承认不便扩大成敌意。

costs-effort-intensity.passage:
When a town announced that its old library might close, campaigners demanded that the building be saved at all costs. Their anger was understandable. Generations had studied there, and a public building carries memories that cannot be priced like office space. But the phrase concealed a difficult question: what other services would have to be reduced to pay for it?

A smaller library in a shared building would lose something valuable. It could nevertheless preserve the service while releasing money for home visits to elderly readers. Recognising that possibility does not mean treating history as worthless. It means accepting that a worthy cause still has to be considered alongside other public needs.
costs-effort-intensity.q: The author suggests that the town should
o: preserve the building whatever other services suffer.
judge the library mainly by the value of its site.
delay any decision until its historical value is priced.
weigh preservation against its other public duties.
costs-effort-intensity.target: 识别at all costs的强度，避免把支持某目标读成不计代价
costs-effort-intensity.skill: 识别at all costs的强度，避免把支持某目标读成不计代价
costs-effort-intensity.answer_support: a worthy cause still has to be considered alongside other public needs

exp.trans: 作者理解居民保护老图书馆的愿望，但指出无论代价地保存建筑会挤占其他服务；替代方案可兼顾借阅与上门服务。
exp.structure: 先承认保护历史的价值，再追问代价，最后说明考虑其他需求并不等于否定历史。
exp.other: at all costs：不惜一切代价；alongside：与……一并考虑；worthy：值得支持的。
exp.meaning: 作者支持把保存建筑与其他公共职责一起衡量。这里要读出at all costs的强度，不能把它只当成努力程度高。
exp.rest: 不顾其他服务的损失延续了作者正在质疑的绝对立场；按地价评价建筑是作者反对的简化；原文没有要求先给历史标价。

interference-capacity.passage:
An audit of a scholarship office found the same calculation error in dozens of applications. The staff had misunderstood a simple scoring rule and had received no training before using it. There was no evidence that applicants had pressured the office to change their marks. The review described the failures as incompetence rather than favouritism.

That distinction matters for the response. A clearer rule and supervised training could address the problem identified by the audit. Investigating influence from outside groups would answer a different question. An institution can make serious mistakes because its staff cannot perform a task properly, even when nobody is trying to interfere with their decisions.
interference-capacity.q: The word "incompetence" in Paragraph 1 most nearly means
o: deliberate pressure from outsiders.
unfair preference for certain applicants.
lack of ability to perform a task properly.
refusal to disclose a successful procedure.
interference-capacity.target: 在确有能力不足证据时正确识别incompetence
interference-capacity.skill: 在确有能力不足证据时正确识别incompetence
interference-capacity.answer_support: its staff cannot perform a task properly

exp.trans: 审计发现工作人员误解计算规则且未受培训，没有外部施压证据，因此判断为能力不足而非偏袒。
exp.structure: 先给事实并区分原因，第二段说明不同原因需要不同的应对。
exp.meaning: 正确项对应不能适当完成工作。本题不是教成凡遇制度问题都选利益干预，而是按材料判断。
exp.rest: 外部施压和偏袒均被文中排除；拒绝公开成功做法没有事实支持。

attribution-stance.passage:
A developer has received permission to turn a disused office block into flats. The planning officer says the proposal meets the rules on floor space and access. On those grounds, she regards the assessment as complete. A local columnist is less satisfied. The small flats may be legal, he notes, yet many have windows facing a busy delivery yard.

The officer is right to apply the existing rules. But compliance is a starting point for judging a home, not a complete account of its quality. A system that records the width of a doorway but scarcely asks what living behind it would be like risks mistaking an approved building for a good place to live.
attribution-stance.q: The author argues that the planning assessment
o: should focus on the developer's ability to make a profit.
has prevented residents from moving into suitable homes.
gives too little attention to the quality of daily life.
has applied stricter standards than the existing rules require.
attribution-stance.target: 区分监管人员的合规判断与作者进一步提出的评价
attribution-stance.skill: 区分监管人员的合规判断与作者进一步提出的评价
attribution-stance.answer_support: compliance is a starting point for judging a home, not a complete account of its quality

exp.trans: 规划人员依据面积和出入规定批准住宅改造，作者承认依法评估的必要性，但认为居住体验没有得到充分考虑。
exp.structure: 先呈现官员的判断及专栏作者的疑问，末段提出“合规不等于宜居”的进一步论点。
exp.other: compliance：遵守规定；delivery yard：装卸院；assessment：评估。
exp.meaning: 正确项属于作者的批评：评估遗漏实际生活质量。不能把官员认为审查已完成的结论当作作者也认可。
exp.rest: 盈利不是作者提出的评估重点；文中没有阻止居民入住的事实；官员按现行规则评估，并没有采用更严格的标准。
